NETWORK.NAME: Parkinsonism_F3_draft
NETWORK.PROPERTY: clinical_validity=none; reference tables are synthetic structural placeholders, not patient estimates
ordering_contract=child state fastest, last declared parent next, first parent slowest
gate=encounter.kind == followup AND parkinsonism effect status == present; absent yields not_applicable, not_assessed or missing yields needs_clarification
sas_rule=SAS findings are measurement only; no SAS total, mean, or historical threshold defines mild, moderate, or severe bands in this draft

cdss_restriction=STATEMENT-12 Quality Measurement Considerations: suggestion 2C is not appropriate for quality measurement or electronic decision support; this package offers research review prompts only, pending owner resolution

VARIABLE.NAME: ParkinsonismSeverity
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Parkinsonism severity (current, functional/urgent categories)

definition=Current parkinsonian signs categorized by documented functional limitation/fall or urgent features. Meaningful only when the follow-up effect status is present. No SAS mild/moderate/severe bands are used.
source=history-effects-v0.1-draft parkinsonism severity (awaiting_review) + docs/medical-docs/parkinsonism-criteria.md documentation rule (falls/functional limitations) and urgent NMS paragraph
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AttributionContext
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Parkinsonism attribution context

definition=Whether antipsychotic-associated parkinsonism is assessed after onset/medication-change review and exclusion of alternatives (Parkinson disease, other neurology, catatonia, negative symptoms, depressive slowing, unmasking); alternative_or_unresolved covers an assessed differential or delayed-recovery reassessment. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=parkinsonism-criteria.md Clinical assessment and exclusions; STATEMENT-12 Implementation; field proposed, not collected
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: DoseReductionFeasible
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Dose-reduction feasibility (presence only)
definition=Clinician-assessed feasibility of antipsychotic dose reduction; no numerical reduction, dose, or automatic action implied. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-12 Implementation dose-reduction paragraph; BN-12 DoseReductionFeasible lead; field proposed, not collected
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: SwitchFeasible
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Lower-parkinsonism-risk switch feasibility
definition=Clinician-assessed feasibility of switching to an antipsychotic with lower parkinsonism propensity; candidate review required, no product choice. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-12 Implementation (Statement 4 Table 6 background); BN-12 LowerParkinsonismRiskSwitchFeasible lead; field proposed
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: PsychosisTradeoffConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Psychotic-worsening tradeoff concern
definition=Patient-specific concern about psychotic worsening with dose reduction or switching; absent does not mean zero risk. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-12 Implementation tradeoff paragraph; BN-12 PsychoticWorseningConcern lead; field proposed, not collected
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: MedicationPreferenceConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Symptomatic-medication preference concern
definition=Patient expresses concern or reluctance about symptomatic medication, including bother from anticholinergic effects; absent does not establish consent. Proposed structured field.
source=STATEMENT-12 Patient Preferences; BN-12 ParkinsonismMedicationPreferenceConcern lead; field proposed
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AnticholinergicSafetyConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Anticholinergic safety concern
definition=Assessed cognitive, urinary, bowel, ocular, cardiac, thermoregulatory or other anticholinergic safety concern. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-12 Implementation anticholinergic-effects paragraphs; BN-12 AnticholinergicSafetyConcern lead; field proposed
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: OlderAgeVulnerability
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Older-age vulnerability
definition=Clinician-assessed vulnerability related to older age; no invented age cutoff. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-12 Implementation older-individuals paragraph; BN-12 OlderAgeVulnerability lead; field proposed, not collected
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: OtherAnticholinergicBurden
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Other anticholinergic burden
definition=Clinically relevant anticholinergic burden from concomitant medications, excluding the target parkinsonism treatment; drug identities only. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-12 Implementation concomitant-medication paragraph; BN-12 OtherAnticholinergicBurden lead; field proposed, not collected
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

source=STATEMENT-12 Implementation lowest-dose/shortest-duration paragraph; BN-12 CurrentParkinsonismAnticholinergicUse lead
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: PriorSignificantParkinsonism

status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: TardiveDyskinesiaConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Coexisting tardive-dyskinesia concern

definition=Assessed possible or coexisting tardive dyskinesia; not mutually exclusive with parkinsonism and assessed separately from the F1 effect status. Anticholinergics can worsen TD. Proposed field.
source=STATEMENT-12 Implementation TD-distinction paragraph; BN-12 TardiveDyskinesiaConcern lead; field proposed, not collected
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: IndicationReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Parkinsonism indication review output

definition=Posterior over review prompts: established association prompts option discussion; unresolved findings prompt differential assessment. Absence is gated, never a posterior. Not a treatment choice.
source=proposed for review; STATEMENT-12 suggestion 2C applied only as review wording, never as a probability
status=proposed_output_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: RegimenReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Antipsychotic regimen review output
definition=Posterior over dose/switch review prompts with psychosis-tradeoff priority; prioritize does not prohibit change and all changes require symptom monitoring. Not a prescription.
source=proposed for review; STATEMENT-12 Implementation tradeoff wording
status=proposed_output_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: SafetyReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Anticholinergic safety review output
definition=Posterior over enhanced vs routine individualized review; routine is not medical clearance and each concern remains visible.
source=proposed for review; STATEMENT-12 Harms and older-individuals paragraphs
status=proposed_output_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: SymptomaticMedicationReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Symptomatic medication review output
definition=Posterior over TD-differential, patient-concerns, and anticholinergic-option discussion prompts; discussion is not a recommendation to start medication.
source=proposed for review; STATEMENT-12 Implementation anticholinergic paragraphs
status=proposed_output_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ContinuationReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Anticholinergic continuation review output
definition=Posterior over lowest-dose/shortest-duration review vs reassessment vs no-rule; reassessment never mandates abrupt withdrawal.
source=proposed for review; STATEMENT-12 lowest-dose/shortest paragraph
status=proposed_output_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AmantadineReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Amantadine review output

status=proposed_output_for_review

VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Prophylaxis review output
